environment.description: ECS Fargate service consuming from SQS queue 'order-events-prod'. The SQS queue policy allows sqs:SendMessage from any principal in the same AWS account (Resource: *). The service runs behind an internal ALB on port 8080 for health checks only. No message validation or filtering is applied at the queue level. IAM role attached to producer services grants broad sqs:* permissions. Any service in the VPC can publish messages with arbitrary message attributes to the queue.

config.network: internal VPC, no ingress restrictions on SQS
config.alb: internal ALB, HTTP listener, no auth
